args.title: Brightline Freight: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — summary
args.body:
• Newsletter: Brightline Freight's latest newsletter spotlights "Cold-chain logistics in 2026," linking to a feature article on their blog.
• Article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, and most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• Companion piece: Pilot programs cut claims by a quarter.
